function backgroundImagesCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.fontSize='20px';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');parent.style.cssText='font-size:20px;color:red';document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const red='rgb(255, 0, 0)',blue='rgb(0, 0, 255)',green='rgb(0, 128, 0)',transparent='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)';
  const gradient=(items,head='')=>`linear-gradient(${head?head+', ':''}${items})`;
  const plain=gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`);
  const check=(name,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;checks[name]=s.backgroundImage===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('background-image')===expected&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width===40&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height===10;};
  check('default','','none');check('none','background-image:none','none');check('linear','background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)',plain);
  check('bottom','background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,red,blue)',plain);check('top','background-image:linear-gradient(to top,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'to top'));
  check('right','background-image:linear-gradient(to right,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'to right'));
  check('corner','background-image:linear-gradient(to top right,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'to right top'));
  check('degrees','background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'45deg'));
  check('radians','background-image:linear-gradient(1rad,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'57.2958deg'));
  check('turns','background-image:linear-gradient(.25turn,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'90deg'));
  check('grad','background-image:linear-gradient(100grad,red,blue)',gradient(`${red}, ${blue}`,'90deg'));
  check('current','background-image:linear-gradient(currentcolor,transparent)',gradient(`${red}, ${transparent}`));
  check('alpha','background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,0,0,.5),blue)',gradient(`rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5), ${blue}`));
  check('pixels',`background-image:linear-gradient(red ${v+3}px,blue)`,gradient(`${red} ${v+3}px, ${blue}`));
  check('em','background-image:linear-gradient(red 1.5em,blue)',gradient(`${red} 30px, ${blue}`));
  check('rem','font-size:30px;background-image:linear-gradient(red 1.5rem,blue)',gradient(`${red} 30px, ${blue}`));
  check('absolute','background-image:linear-gradient(red 1in,blue)',gradient(`${red} 1in, ${blue}`));
  check('percentage','background-image:linear-gradient(red 20%,blue 100%)',gradient(`${red} 20%, ${blue} 100%`));
  check('negative','background-image:linear-gradient(red -2px,blue)',gradient(`${red} -2px, ${blue}`));
  check('doubleStop','background-image:linear-gradient(red 0% 20%,blue)',gradient(`${red} 0%, ${red} 20%, ${blue}`));
  check('hint','background-image:linear-gradient(red,50%,blue)',gradient(`${red}, 50%, ${blue}`));
  check('repeating','background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(red 0px,blue 10px)',`repeating-linear-gradient(${red} 0px, ${blue} 10px)`);
  check('layers','background-image:none,linear-gradient(red,blue),none',`none, ${plain}, none`);
  check('multiple','background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue),linear-gradient(blue,red)',`${plain}, ${gradient(`${blue}, ${red}`)}`);
  check('specificity','',plain,'div{background-image:none}#target{background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)}');
  check('sourceOrder','',plain,'#target{background-image:none}#target{background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)}');
  check('inlineOrigin','background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)',plain,'#target{background-image:none}');
  check('important','background-image:none',plain,'#target{background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)!important}');
  check('cascadeLayers','',plain,'@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{background-image:none}}@layer late{div{background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)}}');
  check('variable','--image:linear-gradient(red,blue);background-image:var(--image)',plain);
  check('invalidVariable','background-image:var(--missing)','none');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(currentcolor 1em,blue)';
  check('notInherited','','none');check('unset','background-image:unset','none');check('initial','background-image:initial','none');
  check('inherit','color:green;font-size:40px;background-image:inherit',gradient(`${green} 20px, ${blue}`));
  e.style.cssText='background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)';e.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient()';checks.invalidGradient=s.backgroundImage===plain;
  e.style.backgroundImage='auto';checks.invalidKeyword=s.backgroundImage===plain;
  e.style.setProperty('BACKGROUND-IMAGE','none','important');checks.cssom=s.backgroundImage==='none'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('background-image')==='important';
  checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('background-image')==='none'&&s.backgroundImage==='none';
  e.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(currentcolor 1em,blue)';e.style.color='green';e.style.fontSize='30px';checks.liveContext=s.backgroundImage===gradient(`${green} 30px, ${blue}`);
  sheet.textContent='#target{background-image:linear-gradient(red,blue)!important}';checks.liveSheet=s.backgroundImage===plain;sheet.textContent='#target{background-image:none!important}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.backgroundImage==='none';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).backgroundImage===gradient(`${red} ${v+3}px, ${blue}`);
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};
  checks.readOnly=throws(()=>{s.backgroundImage='none'},'NoModificationAllowedError');checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('background-image')==='';checks.uppercase=s.getPropertyValue('BACKGROUND-IMAGE')==='none';
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.backgroundImage==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.backgroundImage==='none';
  sheet.remove();return checks;
}
